description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

UNCOMN is seeking a junior software developer to support F-15 mission planning software for the USAF and its partners. The role develops, tests, maintains, and integrates software while troubleshooting issues and collaborating with the development team.
Software Developer 1 (Junior) for F-15 mission-planning software, developing and maintaining .NET code and testing integrations

Responsibilities:
• Support the F-15 mission planning software and ensure successful missions for the USAF and our partners. This position works with a small development team to plan, execute, and enhance existing F-15 functionality
• Under general supervision, develop, document, maintain, and unit test software design code by applying established methods and practices in a .NET environment
• Perform troubleshooting of defects, operational, and integration issues
• Document deployed processes and tools, collect metrics, and gather and organize data for use in plans, schedules, and estimates
• Assist in the specification and maintenance of software requirements
• Perform integration and qualification tests of software in the target environment
• Actively collaborate and participate in software team meetings, design reviews, and peer reviews, while proposing solutions to problems
• Apply exceptional communication skills and the ability to communicate appropriately at all levels of the organization
• Complete tasks that may be broad in nature, requiring originality and innovation in accomplishing tasks

Requirements:
• Bachelor of Science (or greater) degree from an accredited college or university, in engineering, computer science, or similar
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, while performing as a key contributor to a development team
• General Programming Skills with prior experience in software design, debugging, documentation, and testing
• Strong understanding of software development fundamentals, requirements, and the SDLC
• Knowledge of or experience with object-oriented programming
• Must be eligible to obtain a Secret clearance, granted by the US Government as needed, which requires US citizenship
• Must be willing to obtain relevant certifications or complete professional training/development, as required by future client or contract needs

Preferred:
• Active security clearance
• Experience with .NET, C#, Visual Studio, SQL, Windows, and/or Web APIs
